## Context

This is a scoped follow-up to #1 and the implementation in draft PR #2. The source snapshot is commit `9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8`; it is not a claim that the default branch already contains that work. Coordinate the implementation baseline with PR #2 or its merged successor. Issue creation and the ready-for-agent label do not authorize provider launches, trust/permission changes, audit adoption, billing changes or new spending. Follow the execution host’s current policy and preserve existing evidence.

## Triage evidence

- Confirmed current-host inventory mismatch at the pinned commit: 8 installed plugin directories, 1 hook manifest, 0 current-store hook manifests in the acquired snapshot.
- The read-only acquisition made zero provider inference calls. Plugin execution/enablement remains unknown.

**Redundancy check:** Inspected the AGY inventory acquisition, existing hook policy, audit-source binding and provider-control tests. Existing related mechanisms do not satisfy the specific remaining contract below.

**Prior rejection check:** No rejection knowledge base or matching rejection record was present in the inspected checkout. No other follow-up issue existed at triage start.

## Dated source references

- [AGY inventory acquisition snapshot](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/provider-controls.ts)
- [Audit source and disposition contracts](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/control-audit.ts)
- [Existing acquisition regressions](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/test/pilot/provider-controls.test.ts)

The agent-brief comment is the implementation contract. Parent #1 stays open until its independent operational acceptance criteria are met.

**Dependencies:** No sibling prerequisite. Runtime and authorization gates in the brief still apply.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** bug
**State:** ready-for-agent, explicitly requested by the maintainer. This means the specification is ready; dependency or runtime gates are not implied to have passed.
**Summary:** Inventory current Gemini plugin hook sources before audit approval

**Current behavior:**
AGY source acquisition inventories older global and workspace plugin locations but omits the current installed plugin store observed during triage. One hook manifest was present among eight installed plugin directories and none of those current-store manifests appeared in the acquired audit sources. The known Orca-hook policy was present and the audit reported no unavailable entries. Whether that plugin was enabled or executed is not established.

**Desired behavior:**
Inventory every hook/plugin source selected by the qualified current AGY loader contract before an audit can support approval. Distinguish installed, enabled, disabled, absent and unreadable/unknown sources. A complete known-hook execution boundary must not imply that the wider startup inventory is complete.

**Key interfaces:**

- `inspectProviderControls()` and its AGY `ProviderControlEvidence`: acquire the complete current loader inventory.
- `AuditSnapshot.sources`, `effects`, `unavailable`, `recipeHash` and `currentSourceDigest()`: bind inventory completeness and relevant source drift.
- `startup-hooks-and-plugins` and `acquiredAuditDisposition()`: never promote incomplete inventory to verified.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- [ ] Record a portable failing regression on the selected unchanged baseline using an isolated fake home with a current-store plugin hook manifest. It must exercise the real acquisition boundary.
- [ ] Validate current loader locations, discovery order and enablement semantics from version-matched primary evidence. Cover global/workspace/installed sources and manifest/nested hook layouts actually supported by that contract.
- [ ] Installed-but-disabled hooks remain fingerprinted as source metadata; active effects and unknown enablement are represented accurately rather than inferred from file presence.
- [ ] Unreadable, malformed, oversized, symlinked or otherwise unverified inventory produces a specific unavailable/unknown result and cannot discharge the wider audit. Reuse the existing containment and inventory bounds.
- [ ] Changing a relevant manifest, enablement input, inventory root or loader contract invalidates affected audit reuse; unchanged valid evidence remains reusable.
- [ ] The existing five-event Orca-hook boundary and unrelated hook handling retain their source/custody checks. Offline regressions, typecheck and build pass; no real plugin or provider is executed to produce fixture evidence.

**Out of scope:**

- Live Gemini qualification or whole-Council inference; those have separate follow-ups.
- Enabling/disabling plugins, editing global provider settings, trusting directories or approving any effect set.
- Inventing a new version allowlist or restoring retired provider behavior.

**Execution and delivery:**
Work against a revision containing the relevant PR #2 implementation. Recheck the current tree and host policy. Supply portable offline coverage and a reviewable change or validation record, with fresh independent review of material work. Required live evidence must use already-authorized, qualified routes and finite declared call/deadline limits. If a required external capability or permission is unavailable, retain a precise blocker and leave operational completion open; do not substitute a diagnostics-only result for the requested behavior. No global settings, accounts, historical artifacts or unrelated work may be changed under this brief.


**Dependencies:** No sibling prerequisite. Runtime and authorization gates in the brief still apply.
